The '''Skirmish at Klaatu''' was an operation by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] lead by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] to lure the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] into a trap to capture high ranking members and reveal their secret base of operations.

==Background==
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn|Senn]] had learned that the [[Airam Clans]] involvement with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] wasn't full hearted, meaning that they weren't fully coordinated with the Rebel Alliance. Hoping to exploit this they arranged a convoy of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] carrying [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]] and munitions to go through the [[Klaatu system/Legends|Klaatu system]] with the information "leaked" to lure Airam forces into a trap. The [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' was not finished with the retrofit and as such the ''Rage'' decided to continue without it, believing that it would convince the Airam to go ahead without fear of being trapped by [[Gravity well projector/Legends|Gravity well projectors]]. The Rage also warned the pilots to be alert for any rebel starships believing that that they won't let their allies be taken prisoner.

==The Battle==
{{Quote|The Airam have taken the bait, lets "reel" a few in!|Unidentified Imperial Officer|<ref name="xvst">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]''</ref>}}
As expected, the Airam rebels arrived to disable and capture the convoy. All Imperial fighters moved in and engaged the [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Claw Squadron]], while the convoy soon fell under attack from two [[Cargo ferry|Cargo ferries]] ''[[Lausbee]]'' and ''[[Nicko]]'' and the [[R-41 Starchaser]]s from [[Jerrid Squadron]]. Although they lost quite a few fighters, the Imperials managed to punch the T-wings and inflict heavy losses, and started to attack the Cargo ferries. However the R-41 starchasers attacked both the fighters and the Rage in response. However before the ferries could board the convoy craft they suffered serious shield losses, combined with their fighter escorts being unable to stop the Imperial fighters caused them to surrender and power down. The Rage then sent [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] to board and capture the ferries and to repair the convoy to make sure it reaches its destination. The Imperial fighters managed to provide cover against the remaining Airam fighters, eliminating the remnants and soon the transports boarded both the Airam ships and seized them while repairing the convoy craft to allow it to proceed with its mission.

Suddenly multiple [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttles]] called [[Arrow (Escort Shuttle group)|''Arrow'']] arrived to launch [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedoe]] attacks against the ''Rage''. Although the Rage took multiple hits its starfighters managed to destroy the shuttles before the ship would've been forced to withdraw from the battle.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Excellent, the Airam are proving to be completely predictable! The prisoners will soon reveal the location of the pirate base|Unidentified Imperial Officer|<ref name="xvst" />}}
With the capture of the Airam ships and losses incurred the operation proved to the Airam that their involvement with the rebels was not without cost. The prisoners then revealed the location of the base and the Empire sent their forces to destroy it.
